events.content: Create a single-file HTML page (index.html) with all CSS and JavaScript inline and zero external assets. Render a dark, atmospheric hero scene featuring a single, steaming bowl of vegan ramen as the sole visual focus. Make the dish feel alive and appetizing — with natural motion, ambient warmth, and interactive response to the mouse. Keep the scene pure (no UI, text, or menus), responsive on all screens, and respectful of prefers-reduced-motion.

input.content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Vegan Ramen</title>
<style>
  html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: #07050a; overflow: hidden; }
  canvas { display: block; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; height: 100dvh; touch-action: none; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" aria-label="A steaming bowl of vegan ramen" role="img"></canvas>
<script>
(() => {
  const cv = document.getElementById('c');
  const ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
  const mq = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  let reduced = mq.matches;
  let W, H, DPR, S, cx, cy, rx, ry;
  let bowlLayer, foodLayer;
  const mouse = { x: 0.5, y: 0.4, tx: 0.5, ty: 0.4, vx: 0, vy: 0, active: false };
  let steam = [];

  // Seeded random so the bowl looks the same after resizes
  let seed = 7;
  const rnd = () => ((seed = (seed * 16807) % 2147483647) / 2147483647);

  function resize() {
    DPR = Math.min(devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    W = innerWidth; H = innerHeight;
    cv.width = W * DPR; cv.height = H * DPR;
    S = Math.min(W, H * 1.25);
    cx = W / 2; cy = H * 0.56;
    rx = S * 0.36; ry = rx * 0.36;
    buildLayers();
    steam = [];
    const n = reduced ? 10 : 46;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) steam.push(newWisp(true));
  }

  function mk() {
    const c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = W * DPR; c.height = H * DPR;
    const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.scale(DPR, DPR);
    return [c, g];
  }

  function buildLayers() {
    let g;
    [bowlLayer, g] = mk();
    // table shadow
    let sh = g.createRadialGradient(cx, cy + ry * 1.9, 0, cx, cy + ry * 1.9, rx * 1.3);
    sh.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)'); sh.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
    g.save(); g.translate(0, cy + ry * 1.9); g.scale(1, 0.28); g.translate(0, -(cy + ry * 1.9));
    g.fillStyle = sh; g.fillRect(0, 0, W, H * 4); g.restore();

    // bowl body
    const depth = rx * 0.78;
    g.beginPath();
    g.ellipse(cx, cy, rx, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI);
    g.bezierCurveTo(cx - rx * 0.9, cy + depth * 0.9, cx - rx * 0.45, cy + depth * 1.05, cx - rx * 0.32, cy + depth * 1.05);
    g.lineTo(cx + rx * 0.32, cy + depth * 1.05);
    g.bezierCurveTo(cx + rx * 0.45, cy + depth * 1.05, cx + rx * 0.9, cy + depth * 0.9, cx + rx, cy);
    g.closePath();
    let bg = g.createLinearGradient(cx - rx, 0, cx + rx, 0);
    bg.addColorStop(0, '#0c0b0d'); bg.addColorStop(0.3, '#2a2226'); bg.addColorStop(0.55, '#3b2e30');
    bg.addColorStop(0.8, '#1a1517'); bg.addColorStop(1, '#070607');
    g.fillStyle = bg; g.fill();
    // glaze band
    g.save(); g.clip();
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      g.beginPath();
      g.ellipse(cx, cy + depth * (0.28 + i * 0.06), rx * (0.97 - i * 0.03), ry * 0.95, 0, 0, Math.PI);
      g.strokeStyle = `rgba(160,60,40,${0.35 - i * 0.1})`; g.lineWidth = S * 0.004; g.stroke();
    }
    let vg = g.createLinearGradient(0, cy, 0, cy + depth);
    vg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); vg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)');
    g.fillStyle = vg; g.fillRect(cx - rx, cy, rx * 2, depth * 1.1);
    g.restore();
    // foot
    g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(cx, cy + depth * 1.05, rx * 0.33, ry * 0.18, 0, 0, Math.PI);
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)'; g.lineWidth = 2; g.stroke();

    // inner rim
    g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(cx, cy, rx, ry, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    let ig = g.createLinearGradient(0, cy - ry, 0, cy + ry);
    ig.addColorStop(0, '#120e10'); ig.addColorStop(1, '#2b2124');
    g.fillStyle = ig; g.fill();
    g.lineWidth = S * 0.006; g.strokeStyle = '#4a3a3a'; g.stroke();

    // Food layer: broth + toppings
    [foodLayer, g] = mk();
    const bx = rx * 0.93, by = ry * 0.88, bcy = cy + ry * 0.07;
    g.save();
    g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(cx, bcy, bx, by, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); g.clip();
    let br = g.createRadialGradient(cx - bx * 0.2, bcy - by * 0.3, 0, cx, bcy, bx);
    br.addColorStop(0, '#e3a45a'); br.addColorStop(0.5, '#b86a2c'); br.addColorStop(1, '#4a2410');
    g.fillStyle = br; g.fillRect(cx - bx, bcy - by, bx * 2, by * 2);
    seed = 11;
    // oil droplets
    for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
      const a = rnd() * 6.283, r = Math.sqrt(rnd());
      const x = cx + Math.cos(a) * bx * r, y = bcy + Math.sin(a) * by * r;
      const s = S * (0.002 + rnd() * 0.008);
      g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y, s, s * 0.45, 0, 0, 6.283);
      g.fillStyle = `rgba(255,${190 + rnd() * 50 | 0},90,${0.25 + rnd() * 0.35})`; g.fill();
    }
    // noodles
    for (let i = 0; i < 38; i++) {
      const y0 = bcy - by * 0.55 + rnd() * by * 1.2;
      const amp = by * (0.05 + rnd() * 0.08), fr = 3 + rnd() * 4, ph = rnd() * 6;
      g.beginPath();
      for (let t = 0; t <= 1.001; t += 0.02) {
        const x = cx - bx * 0.75 + t * bx * 1.1 + Math.sin(i) * bx * 0.15;
        const y = y0 + Math.sin(t * fr + ph) * amp;
        t === 0 ? g.moveTo(x, y) : g.lineTo(x, y);
      }
      g.lineCap = 'round';
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(80,45,10,0.5)'; g.lineWidth = S * 0.011; g.stroke();
      g.strokeStyle = `hsl(${42 + rnd() * 8},${70 + rnd() * 15}%,${62 + rnd() * 12}%)`; g.lineWidth = S * 0.0075; g.stroke();
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,250,215,0.45)'; g.lineWidth = S * 0.0022; g.stroke();
    }
    g.restore();

    const sc = S / 1000;
    // nori sheets at back
    for (const [ox, rot] of [[-0.42, -0.25], [-0.28, -0.08]]) {
      g.save(); g.translate(cx + bx * ox, bcy - by * 0.72); g.rotate(rot);
      g.fillStyle = '#0f1a12'; g.fillRect(-45 * sc, -150 * sc, 95 * sc, 170 * sc);
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(60,90,55,0.35)';
      for (let k = 0; k < 40; k++) g.fillRect((-45 + rnd() * 90) * sc, (-150 + rnd() * 165) * sc, 3 * sc, 1.5 * sc);
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'; g.lineWidth = 2 * sc; g.strokeRect(-45 * sc, -150 * sc, 95 * sc, 170 * sc);
      g.restore();
    }
    // bok choy
    const bok = (x, y, rot, s) => {
      g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.rotate(rot); g.scale(s * sc, s * sc * 0.65);
      const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-90, 0, 90, 0);
      lg.addColorStop(0, '#1e5a1f'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, '#4f9a37'); lg.addColorStop(1, '#1f4d1b');
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, 60);
      g.bezierCurveTo(-110, 20, -100, -110, 0, -120);
      g.bezierCurveTo(100, -110, 110, 20, 0, 60);
      g.fillStyle = lg; g.fill();
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-22, 110); g.quadraticCurveTo(-30, 0, 0, -60); g.quadraticCurveTo(30, 0, 22, 110); g.closePath();
      const sg = g.createLinearGradient(-25, 0, 25, 0);
      sg.addColorStop(0, '#b9d98c'); sg.addColorStop(0.5, '#eef7d4'); sg.addColorStop(1, '#a8cb7a');
      g.fillStyle = sg; g.fill();
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(20,50,10,0.4)'; g.lineWidth = 3;
      for (const v of [-1, 1]) { g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, -40); g.quadraticCurveTo(v * 50, -50, v * 70, -80); g.stroke(); }
      g.restore();
    };
    bok(cx + bx * 0.5, bcy - by * 0.25, 0.9, 1.25);
    bok(cx + bx * 0.62, bcy + by * 0.1, 1.5, 1.05);
    // shiitake
    const shroom = (x, y, rot, s) => {
      g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.rotate(rot); g.scale(s * sc, s * sc * 0.7);
      const mg = g.createRadialGradient(-12, -12, 5, 0, 0, 55);
      mg.addColorStop(0, '#9a6a44'); mg.addColorStop(0.7, '#5a3520'); mg.addColorStop(1, '#2c170c');
      g.beginPath(); g.arc(0, 0, 52, 0, 6.283); g.fillStyle = mg; g.fill();
      g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(240,220,190,0.75)'; g.lineWidth = 5;
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-22, -20); g.lineTo(22, 20); g.moveTo(22, -20); g.lineTo(-22, 20); g.stroke();
      g.restore();
    };
    shroom(cx - bx * 0.05, bcy - by * 0.5, 0.3, 0.95);
    shroom(cx + bx * 0.16, bcy - by * 0.58, -0.4, 0.8);
    shroom(cx + bx * 0.05, bcy - by * 0.2, 0.8, 0.85);
    // tofu cubes
    const tofu = (x, y, s) => {
      const w = 48 * s * sc, h = w * 0.55, d = w * 0.5;
      g.save(); g.translate(x, y);
      g.fillStyle = '#c98a3e';
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-w / 2, 0); g.lineTo(w / 2, 0); g.lineTo(w / 2, d); g.lineTo(-w / 2, d); g.fill();
      g.fillStyle = '#a56a2a';
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(w / 2, 0); g.lineTo(w / 2 + h * 0.5, -h); g.lineTo(w / 2 + h * 0.5, d - h); g.lineTo(w / 2, d); g.fill();
      const tg = g.createLinearGradient(0, -h, 0, 0);
      tg.addColorStop(0, '#f6d7a0'); tg.addColorStop(1, '#e3b06a');
      g.fillStyle = tg;
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-w / 2, 0); g.lineTo(-w / 2 + h * 0.5, -h); g.lineTo(w / 2 + h * 0.5, -h); g.lineTo(w / 2, 0); g.fill();
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(120,60,20,0.35)';
      for (let k = 0; k < 6; k++) g.fillRect(-w / 2 + rnd() * w, -h * rnd(), 2 * sc, 2 * sc);
      g.restore();
    };
    tofu(cx - bx * 0.52, bcy + by * 0.05, 1.1);
    tofu(cx - bx * 0.38, bcy + by * 0.3, 1.0);
    tofu(cx - bx * 0.62, bcy + by * 0.35, 0.95);
    tofu(cx - bx * 0.3, bcy - by * 0.02, 0.9);
    // corn
    for (let i = 0; i < 34; i++) {
      const x = cx + bx * (0.02 + rnd() * 0.25), y = bcy + by * (0.25 + rnd() * 0.45);
      g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y, 7 * sc, 5 * sc, rnd(), 0, 6.283);
      g.fillStyle = `hsl(${46 + rnd() * 6},95%,${55 + rnd() * 10}%)`; g.fill();
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,220,0.7)'; g.fillRect(x - 2 * sc, y - 3 * sc, 2 * sc, 2 * sc);
    }
    // scallions
    for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
      const a = rnd() * 6.283, r = Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.75;
      const x = cx + Math.cos(a) * bx * r, y = bcy + Math.sin(a) * by * r;
      g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(x, y, 8 * sc, 4.5 * sc, rnd() * 3, 0, 6.283);
      g.strokeStyle = `hsl(${95 + rnd() * 20},60%,${38 + rnd() * 15}%)`; g.lineWidth = 3.2 * sc; g.stroke();
      g.fillStyle = 'rgba(200,240,160,0.35)'; g.fill();
    }
    // chili threads
    g.lineCap = 'round';
    for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
      const x = cx - bx * 0.05 + (rnd() - 0.5) * bx * 0.3, y = bcy + by * 0.05 + (rnd() - 0.5) * by * 0.3;
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(x, y); g.quadraticCurveTo(x + 10 * sc, y - 12 * sc, x + (rnd() * 30 - 5) * sc, y - rnd() * 10 * sc);
      g.strokeStyle = '#d4291a'; g.lineWidth = 1.6 * sc; g.stroke();
    }
    // sesame
    for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {
      const a = rnd() * 6.283, r = Math.sqrt(rnd()) * 0.8;
      g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(cx + Math.cos(a) * bx * r, bcy + Math.sin(a) * by * r, 3 * sc, 1.6 * sc, rnd() * 3, 0, 6.283);
      g.fillStyle = rnd() > 0.3 ? '#f3e6c4' : '#1a1210'; g.fill();
    }
    // chopsticks resting on rim
    g.save(); g.translate(cx + rx * 0.2, cy - ry * 0.95); g.rotate(-0.16);
    for (const off of [0, 22]) {
      const cg = g.createLinearGradient(0, off * sc - 6 * sc, 0, off * sc + 6 * sc);
      cg.addColorStop(0, '#6b4424'); cg.addColorStop(0.5, '#b07a45'); cg.addColorStop(1, '#3a2312');
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-rx * 0.9, off * sc - 4 * sc); g.lineTo(rx * 1.1, off * sc - 7 * sc);
      g.lineTo(rx * 1.1, off * sc + 7 * sc); g.lineTo(-rx * 0.9, off * sc + 4 * sc); g.closePath();
      g.fillStyle = cg; g.fill();
    }
    g.restore();

    // inner rim shadow over food
    g.save();
    g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(cx, cy, rx, ry, 0, 0, 6.283); g.clip();
    const rs = g.createRadialGradient(cx, cy + ry * 0.2, rx * 0.6, cx, cy, rx * 1.05);
    rs.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); rs.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.55)');
    g.fillStyle = rs; g.fillRect(cx - rx, cy - ry, rx * 2, ry * 2);
    g.restore();
    // rim highlight
    g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(cx, cy, rx, ry, 0, Math.PI * 1.1, Math.PI * 1.9);
    g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,220,190,0.25)'; g.lineWidth = S * 0.004; g.stroke();
  }

  function newWisp(init) {
    const a = Math.random() * 6.283, r = Math.sqrt(Math.random()) * 0.75;
    return {
      x: cx + Math.cos(a) * rx * r,
      y: cy + Math.sin(a) * ry * r - (init ? Math.random() * S * 0.6 : 0),
      r: S * (0.03 + Math.random() * 0.05),
      life: init ? Math.random() : 0,
      speed: 0.05 + Math.random() * 0.07,
      ph: Math.random() * 6.283,
      drift: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.4
    };
  }

  let last = performance.now();
  function frame(now) {
    const dt = Math.min(0.05, (now - last) / 1000); last = now;
    const t = now / 1000;
    const k = 1 - Math.pow(0.02, dt);
    const px = mouse.x, py = mouse.y;
    mouse.x += (mouse.tx - mouse.x) * k * 0.8; mouse.y += (mouse.ty - mouse.y) * k * 0.8;
    mouse.vx = mouse.vx * 0.9 + (mouse.x - px) * W * 0.3;
    mouse.vy = mouse.vy * 0.9 + (mouse.y - py) * H * 0.3;
    const mx = mouse.x - 0.5, my = mouse.y - 0.5;

    ctx.setTransform(DPR, 0, 0, DPR, 0, 0);
    // background
    const flick = reduced ? 1 : 1 + Math.sin(t * 1.3) * 0.03 + Math.sin(t * 3.7) * 0.015;
    const lx = cx + mx * W * 0.35, ly = cy - ry * 2 + my * H * 0.2;
    const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(lx, ly, 0, cx, cy, Math.max(W, H) * 0.85);
    bg.addColorStop(0, `rgba(${110 * flick | 0},52,24,1)`);
    bg.addColorStop(0.35, '#2a130b'); bg.addColorStop(0.7, '#0e0708'); bg.addColorStop(1, '#040305');
    ctx.fillStyle = bg; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    // table surface
    const tg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, cy + ry, 0, H);
    tg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(40,22,14,0)'); tg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(20,10,8,0.8)');
    ctx.fillStyle = tg; ctx.fillRect(0, cy, W, H);

    // parallax: bowl slightly shifts, food shifts more
    const ox = -mx * S * 0.012, oy = -my * S * 0.008;
    ctx.drawImage(bowlLayer, ox, oy, W, H);
    const bob = reduced ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 0.9) * S * 0.0015;
    ctx.drawImage(foodLayer, ox * 1.6, oy * 1.6 + bob, W, H);

    // broth sheen following light
    ctx.save();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx + ox * 1.6, cy + ry * 0.07 + oy * 1.6, rx * 0.93, ry * 0.88, 0, 0, 6.283); ctx.clip();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
    const hx = cx + mx * rx * 0.9, hy = cy + my * ry * 0.8;
    const sh = ctx.createRadialGradient(hx, hy, 0, hx, hy, rx * 0.5);
    sh.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,200,130,${0.28 * flick})`); sh.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,160,80,0)');
    ctx.fillStyle = sh; ctx.fillRect(cx - rx, cy - ry, rx * 2, ry * 2);
    if (!reduced) {
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,225,170,0.08)'; ctx.lineWidth = S * 0.002;
      for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        const p = ((t * 0.25 + i / 4) % 1);
        ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(hx, hy, rx * p * 0.6, ry * p * 0.6, 0, 0, 6.283);
        ctx.globalAlpha = 1 - p; ctx.stroke();
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // steam
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';
    const mpx = mouse.x * W, mpy = mouse.y * H;
    for (const w of steam) {
      if (!reduced) {
        w.life += dt * w.speed;
        w.y -= dt * S * w.speed * 0.9;
        w.x += Math.sin(t * 0.7 + w.ph + w.life * 4) * dt * S * 0.02 + w.drift * dt * S * 0.02;
        // mouse interaction: push steam and swirl it
        if (mouse.active) {
          const dx = w.x - mpx, dy = w.y - mpy, d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy, R = S * 0.18;
          if (d2 < R * R) {
            const f = (1 - Math.sqrt(d2) / R);
            w.x += (dx * 0.02 + mouse.vx * 0.6) * f * dt * 20;
            w.y += (dy * 0.02 + mouse.vy * 0.6) * f * dt * 20;
          }
        }
        if (w.life > 1) Object.assign(w, newWisp(false));
      }
      const L = w.life;
      const a = Math.sin(Math.min(1, L) * Math.PI) * (reduced ? 0.07 : 0.11);
      const r = w.r * (0.6 + L * 1.8);
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(w.x, w.y, 0, w.x, w.y, r);
      g.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,235,215,${a})`); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,225,200,0)');
      ctx.fillStyle = g;
      ctx.fillRect(w.x - r, w.y - r, r * 2, r * 2);
    }
    ctx.restore();

    // vignette
    const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(cx, cy, Math.min(W, H) * 0.3, cx, cy, Math.max(W, H) * 0.8);
    vg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); vg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)');
    ctx.fillStyle = vg; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

    if (!reduced) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  function setPointer(e) {
    mouse.tx = e.clientX / W; mouse.ty = e.clientY / H; mouse.active = true;
    if (reduced) { mouse.x = mouse.tx; mouse.y = mouse.ty; requestAnimationFrame(frame); }
  }
  addEventListener('pointermove', setPointer, { passive: true });
  addEventListener('pointerdown', setPointer, { passive: true });
  addEventListener('pointerleave', () => { mouse.active = false; mouse.tx = 0.5; mouse.ty = 0.4; });
  addEventListener('resize', () => { resize(); if (reduced) requestAnimationFrame(frame); });
  mq.addEventListener('change', e => { reduced = e.matches; resize(); last = performance.now(); requestAnimationFrame(frame); });

  resize();
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

events.content:
I've written `index.html` as a single file with everything inline and no external assets. I haven't opened it in a browser or taken a screenshot, so I haven't seen how it actually looks.

**The scene:** a dark ceramic bowl with a red glaze band, drawn at an angle on a candlelit table with warm light and a vignette at the edges. The bowl holds golden broth with oil droplets and a tangle of wheat noodles. On top are shiitake caps with cross-cuts, crisp tofu cubes, bok choy, corn, scallion rings, chili threads, sesame seeds and two sheets of nori, with chopsticks resting on the rim.

**The motion:**
- Steam wisps rise, drift, spread out and fade.
- The warm light flickers gently.
- The bowl bobs very slightly.
- Faint ripples spread across the broth from the highlight.

**Mouse response:**
- The light source and the shine on the broth follow the cursor.
- The bowl and the food move by slightly different amounts, which gives a sense of depth.
- Moving the cursor through the steam pushes and swirls it. Touch works the same way through pointer events.

**Screen sizes:** the scene rescales to any viewport and re-renders when the window is resized. It uses at most 2× pixel density, and the static parts are drawn once in advance so animation stays light.

**Reduced motion:** when `prefers-reduced-motion` is on, the animation loop stops. You get a still frame with softer steam, which only redraws when the pointer moves or the window resizes. It also responds if the setting changes while the page is open.

One small issue I didn't fix: if the reduced-motion setting is turned on and then off again while the page is open, a second animation loop can start and run alongside the first. It only happens after toggling the setting, and the main cost is extra drawing work.

excluded: large base64 and embedded image data (event retained with size marker)
